STEP 1 - Vessel type: flat plate (rectangular/square-ish white plate with a rim band and flat centre, no inner wall).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: the plate looks like a large square/rectangular dinner plate, roughly 25-28 cm across the long dimension.
b) Reference: the pineapple chunks are about 3-4 cm; the plate width spans roughly 7 pineapple-chunk lengths... more usefully, the plate is about 2.5 times the length of the pizza wedge (~11-12 cm per wedge across the body). Estimate width ≈ 25 cm, consistent with a large dinner plate.
Final width: 25 cm (area ≈ 625 cm²; treat as roughly square).

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Pizza (2 wedges, cheese and tomato sauce): covers ~20% of the plate, ~125 cm². Thickness of a slice ≈ 1.5 cm. Volume ≈ 125 × 1.5 = 188 ml × 1.0 ≈ 190 g (cheese and bread mix, a bit lighter; use ~150 g).
- Shredded chicken (white/light meat, mound): ~20% of plate, ~125 cm², average thickness ~2 cm (mound ~half of peak 3-4 cm) → 250 ml × 1.0 ≈ 200 g... mound with gaps, use ~150 g.
- Shredded carrot: ~15% of plate, ~95 cm², thickness ~2 cm (mound) → 190 ml × 0.6 ≈ 115 g.
- Bell peppers (red and green, sliced): ~10% of plate, ~60 cm², thickness ~1 cm → 60 ml × 0.6 ≈ 36 g.
- Pineapple chunks: ~5% of plate, ~30 cm², thickness ~1.5 cm → 45 ml × 0.6 ≈ 27 g.

Hidden food: no clear base layer beyond the chicken; a few small chunks (possibly tofu/chicken) sit under the pizza, add ~10 g.

STEP 4 - Total ≈ 150 + 150 + 115 + 36 + 27 + 10 ≈ 490 g. This is a moderate, not heaped, plate.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g (as served):
- Pizza (cheese/tomato bread): ~260 kcal/100 g
- Shredded chicken: ~165 kcal/100 g
- Shredded carrot: ~40 kcal/100 g
- Bell peppers: ~30 kcal/100 g
- Pineapple: ~50 kcal/100 g

Energy: pizza 390 + chicken 248 + carrot 46 + pepper 11 + pineapple 14 + hidden ~5 ≈ 714 kcal.
